desolate_planet.tip.basic_build_perimete: Building a perimeter around your base can help shield you from mobs at night
desolate_planet.tip.basic_check_spiders: Check your roof, spiders can climb up it in the night
desolate_planet.tip.basic_cobblestone_ge: You can connect the water and lava on the back of the ship together to make a cobblestone generator
desolate_planet.tip.basic_seeds: Seeds for most crops can be found in structures or dropped from sifting dirt
desolate_planet.tip.diet_balanced_diet: It's important to maintain a balanced diet to avoid negative effects. See your nutritional information by clicking the Diet button in your inventory.
desolate_planet.tip.diet_high_fruits: If you eat enough fruits, you will be granted increased health regeneration speed
desolate_planet.tip.diet_high_grains: If you eat enough grains, you will be granted increased movement, mining, and attack speed
desolate_planet.tip.diet_high_proteins: If you eat enough proteins, you will be granted increased attack damage
desolate_planet.tip.diet_high_vegetables: If you eat enough vegetables, you will be granted increased damage resistance and knockback resistance
desolate_planet.tip.diet_low_fruits: Not eating enough fruits will stop natural regeneration
desolate_planet.tip.diet_low_grains: Not eating enough grains will decrease movement, mining, and attack speed
desolate_planet.tip.diet_low_proteins: Not eating enough proteins will decrease attack damage
desolate_planet.tip.diet_low_vegetables: Not eating enough vegetables will increase damage taken
desolate_planet.tip.diet_sugars: Eating lots of sugar will make you faster, but too much will cause weakness and hunger
desolate_planet.tip.drink_acceptable_wat: Acceptable water is usually safe to drink, but has a 5% chance of giving hunger
desolate_planet.tip.drink_camel_pack: A camel pack will automatically drink water for you
desolate_planet.tip.drink_camel_pack_lav: Drinking lava from a camel pack will quickly kill you (why would anyone do that?)
desolate_planet.tip.drink_campfire_purif: Campfires can be used to purify four water bottles at once
desolate_planet.tip.drink_composting_lea: Compost leaves instead of saplings to maximize how much dirt and water you get per tree
desolate_planet.tip.drink_composting_saw: If you break logs into sawdust, you can compost it for more dirt or water
desolate_planet.tip.drink_stillsuit: A stillsuit will regulate body temperature and significantly reduce your water consumption
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crook_drops: Crooks can break leaves for increased sapling drop rates and silk worms
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crook_oak_l: Using a crook on oak leaves will give more drops than other types of leaves
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crucible_la: A crucible can melt stone into lava
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crucible_or: Crucibles can be used to melt down ores or ore chunks
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_crucible_wa: A crucible can melt organic material directly into water
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_aut: Sifting can be automated using a Deployer from Create or with a Mechanical Sieve
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_cru: Sifting crushed blackstone will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances of gold or cobalt
Sifting crushed deepslate will drop common, rare, and very rare ore chunks, plus redstone, lapis, and gemstones
Sifting crushed end stone will drop end ingredients
Sifting crushed netherrack will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances of crimson and warped items
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_dir: Sifting dirt will drop pebbles and random seeds
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_dus: Sifting dust will drop common ore chunks, plus redstone, bone meal, and pebbles
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_gra: Sifting gravel will drop common, uncommon, and rare ore chunks, plus flint, coal, redstone, and diamonds
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_mos: Sifting moss will drop random flowers
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_mul: When placed next to each other, up to nine sieves can be sifted at once
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_pod: Sifting podzol will drop slime and random saplings
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_san: Sifting sand will drop uncommon ore chunks, plus quartz, and certus quartz
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_sou: Sifting soul sand will drop nether ingredients, with extra chances of quartz
desolate_planet.tip.exdeorum_sifting_upg: Upgrade your mesh to get higher yields from sifting
desolate_planet.tip.misc_crafting_end_st: End stone can be made from glowstone in a barrel of lava, or automated in an extruder with liquid ender
desolate_planet.tip.misc_crafting_nether: Netherrack can be made from redstone in a barrel of lava, or automated in an extruder with liquid redstone
desolate_planet.tip.misc_finding_cobalt: Cobalt can be found plentifully in the Foundry structure
desolate_planet.tip.misc_finding_netheri: Debris and netherite can be found in the Foundry structure
desolate_planet.tip.misc_plastic_scraps: Plastic scraps can be found in structures and melted into plastic
desolate_planet.tip.misc_building_gadget: Building gadgets can be used to place or replace large amounts of blocks at once
An Exchanging Gadget can replace a wall of dust with solid blocks, allowing it to be mined without affecting blocks above it
desolate_planet.tip.misc_substituting_pa: Paste can replace slime balls in most recipes
desolate_planet.tip.structures_loot_prev: JEI can show you what loot is found in structure chests
desolate_planet.tip.structures_navigatio: You can make a rover to navigate the wastes easier
desolate_planet.tip.structures_trash_pil: You can find useful scraps by looking through the piles of trash found in structures
desolate_planet.tip.structures_warning_s: Just because you can't see a spawner doesn't mean it isn't there
desolate_planet.tip.tech_mekanism_energy: Redstone dust can be converted directly into energy in any Mekanism machine
desolate_planet.tip.tech_if_dissolution_: Mob spawn eggs can be crafted in a dissolution chamber
desolate_planet.tip.tinkering_crafting_s: Once you have a foundry, more seared stone can be made by melting cobblestone (does not work in a Smeltery)
desolate_planet.tip.tinkering_part_swapp: You can swap the parts of a tool using a tinker station or tinker's anvil
desolate_planet.tip.tinkering_ore_doubli: Ores give higher yields in a smeltery, and even higher yields in a Foundry
